description: Single source of truth for the K'UHUL phase/fold glyph tokens. Every consumer (tokenizer, @kuhul/ts phase runtime, asx-runtime fold/node, Kuhul-c++ native_glyph_engine, and GGUF conversion) MUST derive its glyph ids/names/bindings from this file rather than hardcoding. Reserved-prefix merge (Option A): GPT-2 BPE keeps ids 0..50256 for text; glyphs occupy a reserved block above 50257.
scope: GOVERNS THE DENSE GPT-2 TOKEN STACK ONLY (vocab 50269). This is NOT the DXC MoE/KPI1 GPU stack (DXC/kuhul*.hlsl: vocab_size=32768, 9-expert INT8 MoE, KPI1 opcode ids Pop=0x00..Muwan=0x08, execution folds COMPUTE/STORAGE/META/ROUTING/UI). Those reuse the Maya-month glyph NAMES with their own ids/roles and are a separate model runtime (.mgguf). Do not couple the two here; a token->KPI1 lowering is a separate design step.

notes.fold_default: FOLD_0 (artifact.creation) when an entry's fold is unknown/absent
notes.glyphType: PROPOSED/UNVERIFIED. These hex values (PHASE 0x50xx / SEP 0x5006 / FOLD 0x60xx) are a suggestion for the Kuhul-c++ native_glyph_engine PROTOTYPE only (which currently ships just a DET+NOUN sample opcode). They are NOT used by the DXC MoE GPU stack and match no shipped file yet. Treat as a placeholder until the native engine registers real phase/fold opcodes.
notes.added_token: surface string for GGUF added_tokens (llama.cpp) so the model's glyph embedding rows are reachable from text; also the KXML bracket surface
